import React from 'react'; import { MODE_COLORS } from './WeeklyUtils'; const WeeklyStats = ({ stats }) => { const formatHours = (hours) => { const h = Math.floor(hours); const m = Math.round((hours - h) * 60); return `${h}h ${m}m`; }; const calculateAverage = (total) => { return total / 7; // Average over 7 days }; return (
{/* Focus Time Stats */}

Weekly Focus

Work
{formatHours(stats.totalWork)}
avg: {formatHours(calculateAverage(stats.totalWork))}/day
Leisure
{formatHours(stats.totalLeisure)}
avg: {formatHours(calculateAverage(stats.totalLeisure))}/day
Total Focus
{formatHours(stats.totalWork + stats.totalLeisure)}
avg: {formatHours(calculateAverage(stats.totalWork + stats.totalLeisure))}/day
{/* Break Stats */}

Weekly Breaks

Break Time
{formatHours(stats.totalBreak)}
avg: {formatHours(calculateAverage(stats.totalBreak))}/day
Total Time
{formatHours(stats.totalWork + stats.totalLeisure + stats.totalBreak)}
avg: {formatHours(calculateAverage(stats.totalWork + stats.totalLeisure + stats.totalBreak))}/day
); }; export default WeeklyStats;
